name: coder
description: Secure environments for developers and their agents
one_liner: Lets a company give every developer (or every AI coding agent) a ready-to-use cloud computer instead of setting one up by hand, and shuts it down automatically when nobody's using it to save money.
buyer: A platform engineering lead at a mid-size tech company (200+ engineers) who is tired of new hires spending their first week just getting their laptop set up.
business_use_cases: Onboard new engineers in minutes with a pre-built cloud workspace instead of a multi-day local setup process.
Run AI coding agents inside isolated, auditable company infrastructure so no API keys or code ever touch an unmanaged laptop.
Cut cloud spend by auto-shutting-down idle developer workspaces instead of paying for always-on EC2 instances.

money_ideas.idea: Sell the managed/premium tier with SSO, audit logging, and support to companies too busy to self-host.
Offer implementation consulting to set up Terraform templates for a company's specific infra.

steal_this: Package a one-click 'Coder for [your framework]' template (e.g. a pre-configured Rails or Next.js workspace) and sell setup + support to small dev shops that don't have a platform team.
